free_tier.stated: XS at EUR 3.35/month: 1 Epyc core shared, 1,024 MB RAM, 25 GB NVMe, 5,120 GB/month bandwidth, 1.95 Gbps port, IPv6 only, Warsaw Poland. The tracker's line reads "starting at EUR 3.35 per month". The same XS plan is EUR 3.35 in Stockholm and EUR 4.10 in Warsaw with IPv4 + IPv6, which is the price of a public v4. The provider lists VPS in Poland and Sweden only.

egress.terms: 5,120 GB a month counted on the sum of ingress and egress, then shaped to 10 Mbit/s with the counter reset every 30 days; no overage price is published

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: KVM with root, own ISO images accepted, and a control panel that reinstalls the OS, powers the server and shows load and traffic; the vendor's price table is rendered client-side, so the HTML read carried the prose and not the numbers.
chaining: EUR 3.35 for 5.1 TB a month and a 1.95 Gbps port is the cheapest per byte of transfer, which makes it a relay or a tunnel endpoint in Europe; 1 GB of RAM and 25 GB of disk rule it out as a cache, and the IPv6-only floor means a v4 address costs EUR 0.75 more a month.

limits.value: 5,120 GB a month is 170 GB a day, then the connection is throttled to 10 Mbit/s and the counter resets every 30 days from activation, both stated on the vendor page; the 25 GB NVMe disk and the single core are the tighter limit for anything but a relay.

evidence.proved: the cheapest row quoted: "Hostiko - EUR 3.35 / month" / "cpu 1 Epyc Cores (shared)" / "ram 1,024 MB RAM" / "disk 25 GB NVMe" / "bandwidth 5,120 GB/month bandwidth" / "rj45 1.95 Gbps port speed" / "inet IPv6" / "city Warsaw Poland", under "starting at EUR 3.35 per month"; the Warsaw IPv4 + IPv6 row is EUR 4.10

the post-quota rule translated from the Ukrainian page, not a verbatim quote: traffic is counted on the sum of ingress and egress, after the limit the connection speed is automatically reduced to 10 Mbit/s, and the counter resets every 30 days from server activation; the same page states KVM virtualisation on all VPS plans

the page states it does not provide VPS for tests, transliterated from "My ne nadaiemo virtualni servery dlia testiv", but that any plan can be ordered for a day to check quality; Windows Server 2025, 2022 and 2019 are available on all plans except UA-XS and PL-XS

notes: Price is tracker-only: the vendor's /vps page answered 200 and rendered its FAQ and plan prose, but the prices are templated client-side and no number reached the text extraction. A day-rate trial exists and is paid, so it is not a free tier.
